name: motif_grammar
description: Read grammar. Reads the Baseline grammar by kind and exact object identity. Choose a kind to page through its objects, or omit it for counts.

kind.description: What to list. Omit for counts of every kind. Detailed natural classes include members as {id,symbol}; reuse each member id unchanged in membership edits.

query.description: Only objects whose name or abbreviation contains this text.

exact.description: Only objects whose name or abbreviation equals this text, ignoring case.

id.description: Only the object with this canonical id.

offset.description: Items to skip; a result's nextOffset is the value for the next page.

at.description: What to read: 'baseline' (default) for the current Baseline, or a Proposal id for the grammar its latest Trial ran against, with the Proposal's edits applied. The result returns at, and for a Proposal also atLabel: the Trial's copy of the grammar, not the Baseline.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: Page size for paged reads (findings, operations: default 10; proposals list: default 25), and the most list items in concise mode elsewhere (default 25).

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
